svg.text: Seed3 socket (jumper ends in the right wall), seen from INSIDE, USB-C end on your LEFT
PG-1 wiring, page 5 of 10: The 4 encoders -> Seed3
Back of each encoder: the row of 3 pins at the bottom, the 2 push pins at the top. C and 'push 2' are on the ground-chain page. If a knob turns the
wrong way, flip 'knobs' in the config tab (no rewiring).
Steps (the number is on the wire):
pg-1: A (RIGHT pin of the row of 3) -> Seed3 socket
pg-1: B (LEFT pin of the row of 3) -> Seed3 socket
pg-1: push (LEFT pin of the 2) -> Seed3 socket place 4
pg-2: A (RIGHT pin of the row of 3) -> Seed3 socket
pg-2: B (LEFT pin of the row of 3) -> Seed3 socket
pg-2: push (LEFT pin of the 2) -> Seed3 socket place 7
pg-3: A (RIGHT pin of the row of 3) -> Seed3 socket
pg-3: B (LEFT pin of the row of 3) -> Seed3 socket
pg-3: push (LEFT pin of the 2) -> Seed3 socket place 22
pg-4: A (RIGHT pin of the row of 3) -> Seed3 socket
pg-4: B (LEFT pin of the row of 3) -> Seed3 socket
pg-4: push (LEFT pin of the 2) -> Seed3 socket place 28
